This is critical information! I found the issue. According to the Kubernetes documentation, when a container uses a ConfigMap as a subPath volume mount, it will NOT receive ConfigMap updates automatically. Let me verify the exact configuration of the gateway pods.

From the pod listing, I can see that the gateway pods are mounting the limits ConfigMap with:
- `subPath: "limits.yaml"` 
- `readOnly: true`

The documentation clearly states: [cite: concepts/configuration/configmap#using-configmaps-as-files-from-a-pod-4] "A container using a ConfigMap as a subPath volume mount will not receive ConfigMap updates."

This is also reinforced in another section: [cite: tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-pod-configmap#mounted-configmaps-are-updated-automatically-0] "A container using a ConfigMap as a subPath volume mount will not receive ConfigMap updates."

Now I understand the problem and can provide a fix:

input.note:
**Root Cause**: The gateway pods mount the gateway-limits ConfigMap using a subPath volume mount. According to Kubernetes documentation, containers using ConfigMap subPath mounts do not receive automatic updates. [cite: concepts/configuration/configmap#using-configmaps-as-files-from-a-pod-4] [cite: tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-pod-configmap#mounted-configmaps-are-updated-automatically-0]

**Evidence**: The pod listing shows both gateway pods are mounted with `mountPath: /etc/gateway/limits.yaml`, `subPath: limits.yaml`, and `readOnly: true`. This prevents the gateway from seeing the ConfigMap update made at 09:10.

**Fix**: Remove the subPath from the volume mount so the gateway can receive ConfigMap updates automatically. The gateway should mount the entire ConfigMap directory (without subPath) at /etc/gateway/limits/, or modify the gateway's startup to check for ConfigMap changes. Without removing subPath, the gateway must be restarted to pick up the new limit changes. Ask the infrastructure team to update the gateway deployment to remove the subPath volume mount specification, which will allow future ConfigMap changes to be automatically picked up by the gateway pods.
